questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true for Br 2 at standard temperature and pressure?

options.B: It is a red-brown volatile liquid.
options.C: It is a colorless volatile liquid.
options.D: It is a yellow metallic solid.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It is a red-brown volatile liquid.

questions.stem_text:
A buffer is made from equal concentrations of a weak acid and its conjugate base. Doubling
the volume of the buffer solution by adding water has what effect on its pH?

options.D: It changes the pH asymptotically to the pKa of the acid.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It has little effect.
